newsitem.title: USA: Childtime Q4 March 28 full results.
newsitem.headline: Childtime Q4 March 28 full results.

text.p: Twelve weeks ended Fifty-two weeks ended
NOTES: Full name is Childtime Learning Centers Inc.

(A) Prior-year operating income adjusted to exclude one-time charge of $612,000, to reduce carrying value of land held for disposal to net realizable value for 52 weeks ended March 29, 1996. Prior-year pro-forma net income adjusted to exclude one-time charge of $612,000 to reduce carrying value of land held for disposal, net of $245,000 tax benefit, to net realizable value for 52 weeks ended March 29, 1996.

(B) Prior-year pro forma net income, avg shares and EPS data reflect co's IPO. Prior year pro forma net income also adjusted to exclude extraordinary gain of $241,000 related to debt retirement, net of $93,000 tax effect, for both 12 weeks and 52 weeks ended March 29, 1996.

(C) As result of recently enacted legislation, tax treatment of certain expenses incurred by co in connection with acquisition, for which deductibility challenged by IRS, was clarified. Accordingly, co and IRS reached agreement which resulted in $600,000 tax benefit in FY97 Q3 from reversal of liability established. Current year pro forma net income and EPS adjusted to exclude impact of benefit.
